On Mon, Apr 8, 2024 at 1:54 PM Stephen Brager <[contact omitted]> wrote:
I think repeating the message we have given in the past regarding controlling disinformation, particularly as it regards
efforts to undermining democracy, is important. This includes making the needed investments in personnel and
language translation/algorithms in countries with weaker institutions, where social media is used to harass or persecute
people unfairly. Political stability, democratic governance, and accurate information not only benefit these countries
and the U.S. generally, but creates greater certainty for their (FB's) own investments and longer-term viability. To that
end, I believe the DRG Bureau has talking points they could provide. Copying [contact omitted] Molina and [contact omitted]
O'Neill for them to provide POCs in DRG who can advise on suggested TPs.
smb
STEPHEN M. BRAGER
Office Director, Democracy and Governance
USAID/Guatemala
